get.summary: Returns reservation change log entries sorted by the timestamp

parameters.name: reservationIds
parameters.description: Filter the log entries by reservation IDs

parameters.name: eventTypes
parameters.description: Filter the log entries by event types.

parameters.name: clientIds
parameters.description: Filter the log entries by client IDs (which application triggered this event)

parameters.name: propertyIds
parameters.description: Filter the log entries by property IDs

parameters.name: subjectIds
parameters.description: Filter the log entries by subject IDs (which user triggered this event)

parameters.name: dateFilter
parameters.description:
Filter by event date and time
You can provide an array of string expressions which all need to apply.
Each expression has the form of 'OPERATION_VALUE' where VALUE needs to be of the valid format of the property type and OPERATION can be:
'eq' for equals
'neq' for not equals
'lt' for less than
'gt' for greater than
'lte' for less than or equals
'gte' for greater than or equals
For instance
'eq_5' would mean the value should equal 5
'lte_7' would mean the value should be less than or equal to 7

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: Page number to retrieve. Default: 1. If the page has no items, the API returns 204 No Content.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page. Default: 500. Maximum: 500.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: List of all embedded resources that should be expanded in the response. Possible values are: changes. All other values will be silently ignored.

404.description: The Request-URI could not be found.

503.description: The server is currently unavailable. Please try later.

422.description: Validation errors in the request body or query params.
